sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State.

2.  The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire criminal proceedings of Case No.3585 of 2019 (State vs. Zulfequar and others), arising out of Case Crime No.293 of 2019,
under Sections 41, 411, 413 I.P.C., Police Station Kokhraj, District Kaushambi and charge sheet No.01 of 2019 dated 27.07.2019, under Sections 41, 411, 413, 420, 467, 468 I.P.C. and Impugned Non-Bailable Warrant dated 06.01.2024 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kaushambi,
pending in the court of learned C.J.M., Kaushambi.

opennyai_summary.decision:
2.  The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire criminal proceedings of Case No.3585 of 2019 (State vs. Zulfequar and others), arising out of Case Crime No.293 of 2019,
under Sections 41, 411, 413 I.P.C., Police Station Kokhraj, District Kaushambi and charge sheet No.01 of 2019 dated 27.07.2019, under Sections 41, 411, 413, 420, 467, 468 I.P.C. and Impugned Non-Bailable Warrant dated 06.01.2024 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kaushambi,
pending in the court of learned C.J.M., Kaushambi.
Zulfequar @ Zulfequar Hussain And 7 ... vs State Of U.P. on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132383247/
1
4. This application is dismissed.
5. However, on the request of learned counsel for the applicant, it is directed that in case applicant appears and surrenders before the court below within 60 days from today and applies for regular bail the same shall be considered as per judgement and order of Apex Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, judgement dated 11.7.2022.
6.
For a period of 60 days, the applicant shall not be arrested in the aforesaid case, if not already arrested.
7. However, in case, the applicant does not appears before the court below within the aforesaid period, coercive action shall be taken against him.
8. It is made clear that the applicant will not be granted any further time by this Court for surrendering before the court below as directed above.
